title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations

claims.claim: NVIDIA cuDSS, today launched in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that accelerates engineering and scientific simulations using GPUs.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.

claims.claim: Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in its Ginestra simulation platform by up to 10x using cuDSS compared to CPU-only approaches.

evidence.quote: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches

Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability.

claims.claim: ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS.

evidence.quote: COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark

COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours.

claims.claim: ZEISS SMT completed the full EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark in six days and 14 hours using NVIDIA accelerated computing.

evidence.quote: completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours.

COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours.

claims.claim: Cadence uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs for customers including Nokia.

evidence.quote: Cadence: Uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs, helping customers including Nokia analyze complex designs faster.

claims.claim: Dassault Systèmes reports an 8-10x speedup using cuDSS within its Abaqus structural and computer simulation technology electromagnetic solvers.

evidence.quote: Dassault Systèmes: Dassault Systèmes reports an 8-10x speedup using cuDSS within its Abaqus structural and computer simulation technology electromagnetic solvers for performance-critical simulations across industries.

claims.claim: Siemens uses cuDSS in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ to accelerate simulations of structures in fluid-structure interaction workflows.

evidence.quote: Siemens: Siemens uses cuDSS in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ to accelerate simulations of structures in fluid-structure interaction workflows.

claims.claim: Synopsys uses cuDSS in its Sentaurus Device simulator tool to help Infineon model complex devices faster.

evidence.quote: Synopsys: Synopsys uses cuDSS in its Sentaurus Device simulator tool to accelerate simulations of advanced logic, memory and power chips, helping Infineon model increasingly complex devices faster.
